/bin/zsh -c "nl -ba packages/compiler-core/src/runtimeHelpers.ts | sed -n '42,55p;100,116p'; nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/index.ts | sed -n '372,390p'; nl -ba packages/shared/src/index.ts | head -35; nl -ba packages/shared/src/normalizeProp.ts | sed -n '60,84p'; rg -n 'normalizeClass|@vue/(shared|runtime-core|runtime-dom)|export \\*' packages-private --glob '*.{ts,tsx}' --glob '"'!**/node_modules/**'"'; git status --short"
